extensions.executionLimits: Finite declared scenes phase0..2; unsupported enums fail explicitly; all arithmetic exact integers/rationals, no eval or runtime network. Independent signed rational domain bounded absnumerator1000 and denominators1..1000 for division; positive ratio domain0..1000 denominators1..1000. Parser copied established self-contained exact contract: raw128 limit, normalized decimal4+3 significant places; equivalent unreduced fractions accepted. No unsupported input silently defaults. Optional model step/play1100ms for disclosure only, not physical simulation time. Sibling-root/per-root owner lifecycle; current selectors reread on action/input/change; dispose cleans listeners/timers. Initial staticSVG same state as live reset. Answer uses text keyboard request so slash is available in ordinary mobile text input; exact formats still checked, actual OS keyboard manually unverified. Model-bound judgement is invalidated centrally whenever the current premise changes or becomes unsupported, including silent selection followed by Step/Play; unrelated practice feedback is preserved.
